name: Nocturne
title: the Eternal Nightmare

Q.name: Duskbringer
Q.description: Nocturne throws a shadow blade, dealing 65/105/145/185/225 + 0.85×bonus AD physical damage and leaving a dusk trail for 5 seconds. Enemy champions hit also leave a trail. While on the trail, Nocturne is Ghosted and gains 20/25/30/35/40% Move Speed and 15/25/35/45/55 Attack Damage.
Q.summary: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

W.name: Shroud of Darkness
W.description: Passive: Nocturne gains 30/35/40/45/50% Attack Speed. Active: Nocturne creates a shadow barrier for 1.5 seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability. If an Ability is blocked, this Ability's passive effect is increased to 60/70/80/90/100% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.
W.summary: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.

E.name: Unspeakable Horror
E.description: Passive: Nocturne gains 90% Move Speed toward Feared enemies. Active: Nocturne plants a nightmare tether into his target, dealing 80/125/170/215/260 + 1×AP magic damage over 2 seconds. If the tether remains unbroken, the target is Feared for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.25 second(s).
E.summary: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.

R.name: Paranoia
R.description: Nocturne darkens the map, reducing the sight radius of all enemy champions and removing their vision of allies for 6 seconds. Nocturne can Recast this Ability during the duration to launch himself at an enemy champion dealing 150/275/400 + 1.2×bonus AD physical damage.
R.summary: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

Passive.name: Umbra Blades
Passive.description: Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself. Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.
Passive.summary: Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself. Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: AD diver jungler who darkens the map with R and launches onto isolated targets. Wins with global dives, a spell shield that blocks key crowd control and a fear tether.
strengths: R: global map darkness + long-range dash onto a champion
W blocks the next enemy ability (spell shield) and grants attack speed
E fear tether locks a target if it isn't broken
Q trail: ghosting, move speed and AD
weaknesses: Weaker before 6 than early ganking junglers
E tether can be broken by walking away or dashing
Diving grouped teams gets him killed
No real escape once R is used to go in

curve.lvl2: medium – Q trail ganks are weak without fear
curve.lvl3: medium – E fear ganks if he reaches the target
curve.items: strong – first lethality/bruiser item (Hubris, Eclipse) or Stridebreaker
curve.late: medium – pick tool; struggles against grouped teams

profile.curveNote: R is his ganking and dive tool; before 6 he farms and plays for scuttle.
profile.sustain: medium – passive heals on each cleave
profile.mobility: high – R dash + Q trail speed

Passive.notes: Every few seconds, next attack cleaves and heals (dodgeable by Jax E).

Q.notes: Shadow blade: damage + trail (ghosted, move speed, AD).

W.notes: Blocks the next enemy ability for 1.5 s; bonus attack speed if it blocks.

E.notes: Tether; fears if unbroken after its duration.

R.notes: Map darkness (enemy vision reduced); recast dashes to a champion.

profile.windowAgainst: W down: crowd control him. Walk away to break the E tether. Group when R is up.
